title: Mi familia
subtitle: Talking about your family
scene: {mom} asks about your family. Your details here are samples: change them to fit your real family.

lines.note: Cuéntame = tell me (tú). Cuéntame más = tell me more.
Sample detail. Grande = big, pequeña = small.

lines.es: Tengo una hermana y un hermano.
lines.en: I have a sister and a brother.
lines.note: Sample detail: make it yours. Un hermano, dos hermanas, no tengo hermanos.

lines.en: And where do your parents live?
lines.note: Papás = parents (mom and dad) in Mexico.

lines.es: Viven cerca de mí. Los visito mucho.
lines.en: They live near me. I visit them a lot.

lines.es: Qué bueno. La familia es lo más importante.
lines.en: That’s great. Family is the most important thing.

culture.title: La familia
culture.text: Family is the center of life in Mexico. Asking about someone’s family, and remembering names, builds trust fast.

lines.note: Estoy de acuerdo = I agree. Useful at any table.

lines.en: Someday we want to meet them.

lines.es: ¡Claro que sí! Ellos también quieren conocerlos a ustedes.
lines.en: Of course! They want to meet you too.
